profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Jeddy Holdings LLC
profile.summary:
I have breadth & depth in software technologies. I manage and mentor offshore / onshore resources effectively. I work well with small or large multi-system environments and diverse technologies. I have considerable experience managing risk and reducing or eliminating downtime of Oracle applications during upgrade, patching or maintenance of Oracle databases, networks and servers. I get better as the problem(s) gets more difficult. I love to learn and share my knowledge to my peers and managers. I am smart, versatile, patient and passionate about my work.

Specialties: Large-scale multi-system software development, ASP.NET CORE/MVC, C#, F#, C++, SQL and Visual Studio 2019, Oracle Financials Accounts Receivable development and support, Accounts Receivable conversion and buyback, Project management, EDI setup and implementation, Compiler construction and implementation, Programming language design, Mobile device programming development.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Westchester County, New York, United States
positions.description: Redesign of an Online Inventory System using Blazor Server ASP.NET Core 3.x, Visual Studio 2019, C#, Syncfusion, MS SQL Server and realtime interfaces with Amazon, eBay, Newegg, Paypal and ShipStation.

positions.title: Lead Systems Engineer
positions.description: Lead role in supporting, maintaining and enhancing highly customized Oracle Financials receivables system. Lead role in supporting, scheduling and managing IT / Business sponsored projects in all phases of the project cycle. I maintained good client relationships through regularly scheduled meetings, timely communication and resolution of issues. I supported network / infrastructure groups for system upgrades, patches and testing. I initiated periodic reviews of applications to cut cost or improve efficiencies in runtimes and scheduling. I assisted, mentored and supervised onshore / offshore staff working in our group. I held / attended regularly scheduled meetings with the staff and my manager. I attended seminars or conferences to keep abreast of systems and applications technologies. I proposed or advised mid / long term direction of applications.

positions.title: President
positions.description: Developed, wrote and enhanced a variety of software applications such as auction system, fuzzy search engine for lawyers and video conferencing using Microsoft Windows SDK, Visual Basic, C++.

positions.title: Independent Consultant
positions.description: Developed, wrote and assisted in writing parser modules for an IBM clinical application system using AIX UNIX, Korn shell scripting, C++.

positions.title: Independent Consultant
positions.description: Developed, wrote and enhanced a mail sorting application in Visual Basic.

positions.title: Independent Consultant
positions.description: Developed, wrote and enhanced a compiler / interpreter for a proprietary language using C++.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed, wrote and enhanced a compiler / interpreter for a proprietary object oriented language using C++.

positions.title: Programmer
positions.description: Developed and wrote packet / data streams for a proprietary massively parallel computer operating system using 68000 assembler.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Assisted, developed, wrote and enhanced porting of FOCUS to IBM PC using 8088 assembler and C language.
